question: ______ is a popular folk dance of Minicoy Island.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lava.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lava is the folk dance form of Lakshadeep's Minicoy Island.**
 
• It is a** folk dance performed mainly by the Lakshadweep males.**
 
• It is a renowned traditional style of** dance performed on festive occasions.**
 
• The word '**Lava' signifies the beautiful movement of music, **song, and rhythm.
 
• Lava dance is the most popular dance on Lakshadweep Minicoy Island.
 
• First, line up the performers themselves in pairs or singles carrying drums, and launch a dance according to drum beating.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Leshalaptu **

 
 
• **​It is a folk dance of Nagaland.**
 
• This dance is **performed by women.**
 
 
 
• **​Moyashai**
 
 
• **​It is also one of the folk dances of Nagaland.**
 
• It is a victory dance **performed by the Lotha tribe **of Nagaland.
 
 
 
• **Aaluyattu**
 
 
• ​Aaluyattu is a** folk dance **form from the state of **Nagaland.**
 
• The dance is **performed by the Konyak tribe.**
